scope: New, verifiable console-origin native mobile ports/recompilations with Android ARM64 targets; desktop outputs are included when the same project supports them.

projects.title: Galaxy Android — Super Mario Galaxy Native Android Port
projects.status: Experimental early release; the latest published GitHub release found is v0.0.1c (2026-10-15), with an Android APK. The maintainer lists Android 11/API 30+, arm64-v8a, Vulkan 1.0 or OpenGL ES 3.2, and a user-supplied Wii disc image. The README does not establish full-game completion or broad device compatibility.
projects.summary: Native Android ARM64 port of Super Mario Galaxy built on the Petari Wii decompilation and GalaxyQuest mobile-port work. It adds Android rendering, touch/gyro/gamepad input, and a disc-import flow; the repository and APK exclude the game's assets and require the user's own disc dump.
projects.strategy: Decompilation-based native ARM64 port; project documentation describes Vulkan 1.0 rendering with an OpenGL ES 3.2 backend.
projects.source_available: Public source repository and Android APK release; user-provided Super Mario Galaxy disc required; game data is not included.
projects.subtype: Wii decompilation-based Android port; early release and limited device validation

projects.title: NHL 07 Original Xbox Native Android Port
projects.status: Playable experimental Android release v0.4.3 (2026-10-15), with APK and matching source archive. Android 10+, ARM64, and OpenGL ES 3.0 are required; the Anbernic RG477M/Mali is the validated target. Release validation covers an active five-minute match, audio, and HOME/return cycles, but not every season, mode, or save/load scenario; other devices are not comprehensively tested.
projects.summary: Native Android ARM64 port of the USA Original Xbox NHL 07, with touch and controller mappings, an OpenGL ES renderer, English/Russian text settings, and a converter for supported NHL Legacy Xbox 360 roster updates. Users provide their own Xbox disc image; the repository and release do not include the full disc, XBE, or VIV game files.
projects.strategy: Native recompilation of the Original Xbox game code for ARM64, with Android launcher/input/audio integration and a system OpenGL ES renderer.
projects.source_available: Public source repository and v0.4.3 APK/source release; user-supplied NHL 07 (USA) Original Xbox disc image required; full game files are not included.
projects.subtype: Experimental Xbox-to-Android recompilation; Anbernic RG477M/Mali validated
